entries.symptom: Maximum update depth exceeded after reading a store
entries.cause: A Zustand 5 selector returned a new object or array on every call
entries.fix: Return primitives or stable references, or wrap the selector in useShallow from zustand/shallow

entries.symptom: Screens show old values until the app restarts after a background write
entries.cause: The write went straight to storage, so the stores that mirror it never re-read
entries.fix: Write through the store action (or publish the change to the stores in the same step); never write storage behind a store

entries.symptom: A zod 4 schema crashes or refuses to run in a Hermes release build
entries.cause: zod 4's JIT compiles validators with new Function, which Hermes does not support
entries.fix: Use valibot (the stack default); with zod 4 set jitless mode before any schema runs

entries.symptom: The app crashes at launch after installing an older build over a newer one (the database comes from a newer app)
entries.cause: The open path threw when PRAGMA user_version was newer than the app knows, so every launch crashed before the first frame
entries.fix: Return a 'newer version' outcome from the open path, run read-only or in memory, and show "please update"; never throw while opening

entries.symptom: The app crashes at launch with "file is not a database"
entries.cause: The database file itself is not an SQLite file (never seen with WAL and synchronous FULL)
entries.fix: Handle it as an open outcome: move the file aside as a support copy and start fresh, with the developer's approval of the copy and the message

entries.symptom: A device backup restores older data
entries.cause: Recent writes sit in the -wal file
entries.fix: Run PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) when the app goes to the background (the -wal file drops to 0 bytes)

entries.symptom: Writes get slow as a JSON document grows
entries.cause: The whole document is written on every save
entries.fix: Keep a write-speed test; past about 200 KB move the busy part into its own table or row (the SQLite default avoids this)

entries.symptom: Work is lost although Back opens a confirmation
entries.cause: usePreventRemove does not catch app close, an OS kill, or a screen unmounted by a guard flip
entries.fix: Save as the user goes; the Back confirmation is UX only

entries.symptom: The navigator direction disagrees with the layout for one launch
entries.cause: The direction was derived from the language setting, not I18nManager
entries.fix: Derive navigation direction from I18nManager's current constants

entries.symptom: Push animations slide the wrong way in RTL with headerShown false
entries.fix: Check push and back animations in RTL on both platforms before shipping RTL

entries.symptom: Reduce Motion is on, but screens still slide
entries.cause: The stack always uses the platform push animation
entries.fix: Set animation: 'fade' (or 'none') from the reduce-motion setting in the screen options

entries.symptom: A polling or timer screen keeps working when another screen covers it
entries.cause: Stack screens stay mounted under the screen on top
entries.fix: Start and stop the work with useFocusEffect (and pause on background)

entries.symptom: signal.throwIfAborted is not a function, or signal.reason is undefined, on the device while Jest passes
entries.cause: React Native 0.86 polyfills AbortController with abort-controller 3.0.0, which lacks throwIfAborted and reason; Jest runs Node's full implementation
entries.fix: Check signal.aborted and throw your own abort error; never call throwIfAborted or read signal.reason in app code

entries.symptom: An abort is shown as an error on the device although the code checks error.name === 'AbortError'
entries.cause: expo/fetch rejects an aborted request with a FetchError, not an AbortError
entries.fix: Decide by signal.aborted, not by the error name

entries.symptom: A listener registered with { signal } keeps firing after the abort on the device
entries.cause: React Native's event-target-shim 5 ignores the signal option of addEventListener
entries.fix: Remove listeners explicitly in the cleanup (keep the remove function or subscription)

entries.symptom: "Next in {h} h {m} min" is hours off (it counts to UTC midnight)
entries.cause: It was computed from Date.now() % 86_400_000, which is UTC midnight, not local
entries.fix: Ask the clock port for the time until the next local day (DST-safe); keep day maths out of screens

entries.symptom: A seven-day strip cannot find today's cell by its testID
entries.cause: The cells were numbered by ISO weekday instead of position
entries.fix: Number by position (1 = six days ago, 7 = today); the weekday only picks the label

entries.symptom: TS2741: Property '<member>' is missing in type ... but required in type 'ClockPort'
entries.cause: A hand-written clock object from before the port gained that member
entries.fix: Use the fake clock from the clock service in tests; code that only reads the time takes Pick<ClockPort, ...>
match: is missing in type .* but required in type 'ClockPort'

entries.symptom: A tool writes yesterday's date into a ledger or report shortly after local midnight
entries.cause: It took the UTC calendar day
entries.fix: Write the local calendar day (the date-key helper), and let a --date option override it
